answer: Contribution-Weighted Vertex Scoring: each agent’s influence is a vertex score set by audits of its past outputs. New identities start at zero, so they must spend compute to earn a pulse of visibility per task. Clones multiply audit load without raising score. Each identity also pays a pearl fee per audit, refunded only on passing. A clone thus buys zero influence at full fee, making every marginal copy strictly negative-EV while honest agents recover cost.
